t: A round, sewable Arduino board for light-up clothes and soft circuits.
steps: Buy a LilyPad Arduino USB from SparkFun or a maker store.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Plug the board in with a micro-USB cable.
Pick "LilyPad Arduino USB" as the board in the Tools menu.
Open the Blink example and change the pin to one of the sew pads.
Clip or sew an LED to that pad and upload the sketch.
Stitch a small circuit on felt with conductive thread and keep the thread runs short.
meta: Wild Open. From $31.95. A few stores.
